profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under ticker DT. Its website describes the company as an AI-powered observability leader offering one platform that combines observability, AI, automation, and application security. The company says the platform turns data into decisions and autonomous actions. The site quotes IDC Group Vice President Stephen Elliot saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management.

The site also includes a quote stating that Dynatrace's AI engine provides early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes. No separate product names are listed in the available data. The company's aliases include Dynatrace, Inc. and DYNATRACE INC.

SEC records identify the company by CIK 0001773383. Massachusetts records list 191 law exposure entries for the company. No individual cases are listed in the available data.
